results.title: R.E.V.I.V.E II: Republic of Korea and UNDP expand partnership to advance early recovery in Gaza | United Nations Development Programme
results.content: “The scale of needs in Gaza remains immense, and early recovery is critical to restoring the basic conditions that allow people to remain on or return to their communities with dignity,” said Jaco Cilliers, UNDP/PAPP Special Representative of the Administrator. “The Republic of Korea has been a critical partner in this effort. R.E.V.I.V.E II builds on what we have achieved together, connecting transitional shelter with essential services and neighbourhood-level interventions to support recovery [...] Building on these efforts, R.E.V.I.V.E II will contribute to UNDP’s broader Gaza Neighbourhood Programme, which brings together transitional shelter, debris removal, basic infrastructure, essential services and livelihoods support within the same communities. The approach aims to help Palestinians remain on or return to their areas of origin by progressively restoring the conditions that make neighbourhoods functional — connecting shelter with water and sanitation, health, education and [...] With an allocation of USD 7.76 million, R.E.V.I.V.E II builds on the achievements and lessons of the first phase, with a continued focus on transitional shelter, essential services and integrated neighbourhood-level recovery, helping create the conditions for Palestinians to remain on or return to their communities in safer and more dignified conditions.

results.title: Built Together in Champaign, Leading Together Nationally: Illinois Athletics and Busey Bank Announce Expanded Partnership - University of Illinois Athletics
results.content:
Founded just months apart in 1867 and 1868, respectively, the University of Illinois and Busey Bank have a long and storied history of helping shape Champaign-Urbana and communities across Illinois. Today, both organizations continue to build on that legacy while expanding their impact and recognition well beyond their home state's borders.

Built together in Champaign. Leading together nationally. [...] organizations are experiencing remarkable growth in prominence, reputation and success, and we are excited to help each other further accelerate our respective missions through this exciting partnership." results.title: Ravens, Under Armour announce 10-year partnership extension
results.content:
Audio 1
The Ravens and Under Armour have agreed to a 10-year extension of their longstanding partnership, expanding a relationship between two of Baltimore‘s most recognizable brands.

The agreement will introduce exclusive merchandise, enhanced hospitality offerings at M&T Bank Stadium and continued investments in the Under Armour Performance Center and regional youth football programs. [...] The extension also builds upon Maryland’s decision to recognize girls flag football as a varsity high school sport beginning in 2026. Under Armour and the Ravens intend to use the next decade to continue growing participation while expanding the partnership beyond merchandise and stadium branding.

_Reporting by Glenn Erby, Ravens Wire (USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect)_
